offering_description.value: Makes specialty chemicals, advanced materials, performance additives and fibers sold mainly to manufacturers in many industries, and runs molecular recycling of plastic waste. Produces at its own plants and sells mainly directly to industrial customers.

primary_products.value: specialty polymers; performance additives; specialty fibers; chemical intermediates; coatings resins

customer_segment.value: B2B: manufacturers in transportation, consumer goods, building, packaging and healthcare industries

end_markets.value: transportation; building and construction; consumer goods; healthcare; packaging; agriculture

revenue_model.value: product sales: specialty chemicals, materials and fibers sold to manufacturers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes chemicals and materials from feedstocks, sold to industrial manufacturers; raw materials: chemical intermediates sold to other chemical and materials makers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions, served from its plants and offices

specialization.value: related lines: additives, advanced materials, fibers and chemical intermediates share chemistry platforms and industrial customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to industrial manufacturers; distributors / dealers: chemical distributors serving smaller industrial buyers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: chemical safety, emissions and environmental rules from EPA and EU REACH, plus plant permits
